node.title: Rank-eleven split-pencil planes have a pair-core dichotomy
node.closure: two-support intersection recovery, ordered record-pair petal charge, and exact low-core plane cap
node.statement: Lift one fixed rank-nine affine owner plane to the original KoalaBear row and let J be its common pair core. If |J|<2m-n=134944, every intersection owner for t_p record lines has enough disjoint petal mass to pay its ordered line pairs: t_p(t_p-1)<=981105|P_p|. Hence g(g-1)<=981105(2097152-|J|)<=2057516501910 and g<=1434405. Every plane above this cap has one pair core of size at least 134944 shared by all owners and records. The number and chronology of planes remain open.
